item.title: Yang Xianrong -The Empress of two Chinese kingdoms - History of Royal Women
item.description: Empress Yang Xianrong was the empress of two Chinese kingdoms. She was the second empress consort to Emperor Hui of the Western Jin Dynasty. After Emperor Hui’s death, Yang Xianrong became the Empress Dowager of the Western Jin Dynasty. Emperor Liu Yao burned her palace, kidnapped and married Empress Dowager Yang Xianrong. Therefore, Yan Xianrong became the empress consort to Emperor Liu Yao of the Han-Zhou Dynasty.
